answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: full rewards need 20 distinct counterparties in 3 epochs — a grove is many trees, not one trunk. A newcomer enters light as a zephyr, capped at small trades; each new partner lifts it. A farm's trades rise in one thick plume, so identities sharing 80% of counterparties freeze. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 20,000 relationships: at 5 POA each, 100,000 POA; an honest agent pays once for 20 trades and keeps rewards.
